text: Mobile app development is a process that combines creativity with technical skills. One of the first decisions developers face is choosing between native or cross-platform tools. Native apps are built for a single system, like iOS or Android, which often means better performance and smoother animations. Cross-platform apps, on the other hand, use one codebase for multiple systems, saving time and money but sometimes sacrificing speed. Regardless of the approach, responsive design is essential—the app must look and work well on different screen sizes. Before releasing an app, developers must submit it to app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where rules and review times vary. After launch, regular updates and performance monitoring help keep the app fast and bug-free.
